name: Halvin
personality: Gentle ex-circus performer who dislikes fighting and gets nervous or homesick easily.
story: Halvin grew up on an ordinary farm before joining a travelling circus troupe, and ended up in Anatolia's group by chance. They enjoy street performance, magic tricks, shopping and housekeeping. Recruitment needs Dates (a desert item) on Cai's route, with Renown gates of 5 (Cai), 7 (Theodora/Leda) or 9 (Dietrich).

personalSkill.name: Adaptability
personalSkill.effect: After combat, grants Hit+2 until end of map (max +30). Lv20: Halt Advance (foes who attacked first get Spd-2 through next combat); Lv35: Spd-3.

tierNotes: KeenGamer: A tier (Dex-heavy archer, recruitment needs Dates). Pocket Tactics: B tier.

build.notes: Bench in Part I. He joins in Ch 9 after the Baina trip at about Lv 15, reads the Rubess Forest Riding Manual, and takes Charioteer at Lv 20 with Rider D and Bow C. Charger is mastered in Part I dungeon fights; the class steps up at Lv 35 and 45.

guide.role: Part II chariot archer and debuffer
guide.summary: A Part II chariot archer. He joins in Ch 9, levels in dungeon parties behind Inyoni through Part I, then charges lines and shoots from range 2 from Part II Ch 1. [[art:Leg Shot]] and [[ability:Halt Advance+]] soften a target for the next ally, and Adaptability stacks Hit +2 per combat, so he takes the Ch 5 Deadeye shot on Dagda.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: Leg Shot the foe your striker hits next, or Charge a softened line. He can't dodge: end turns behind the tanks, next to Sha Lan.
keys: Buy 10 Dates at Baina Oasis on the Ch 9 trip; recruit him on return (Support 3, Renown 7)
Read the Rubess Forest Riding Manual on join day: Charioteer needs Rider D
Hunter to Lv 20, then [[class:Charioteer]] in Ch 9 or 10 (Rider D, Bow C)
EXP: a dungeon seat every week; aim at Lv 30? by Ch 12

decisions.why: Every level from Lv 15 grows Hunter and Charioteer rows, and Charger is mastered before Part II. Unrecruited units auto-level on personal growths only, and Part II's catch-up rolls the same way.

decisions.pick: Charioteer from Part II Ch 1 to the end
decisions.why: Charioteer's Path steps growth up at Lv 35 and 45 (Dex 75, 80, 85; Def 40, 50, 60), and Charge feeds Adaptability several stacks a turn. Sniper's Marksmanship (Hit +15) only overlaps Adaptability.
